toleranceRationale: Calibrated from the semantic engine's first REAL HOSTED run over the fixture corpus (2026-08-03), measured on the NATURAL questions (real engines never see memoryQuery) in the SAME 59-doc fixture corpus and harness as lexical. The `semantic` engine is `lexical` with the knowledgeEmbedder slot filled — hybrid RRF search (semantic cosine fused with the existing term-frequency ranking, k=60). The slot is filled by the SHIPPED resolver (`resolveKnowledgeEmbedder`, packages/vendo/src/dev-creds/embedding.ts) over Google `gemini-embedding-2` (the same model Sift uses; pinned via VENDO_MODEL_KNOWLEDGE_EMBEDDER — note the resolver's own default is `gemini-embedding-001`, a DIFFERENT model id, so this must be explicitly pinned) with an embedding key set and VENDO_KNOWLEDGE_EMBED=on. `@ai-sdk/google` is now a harness devDependency so the hosted embedding path actually loads; without it the resolver throws at embed time and the local engine silently falls back to lexical — which is exactly what produced the earlier keyless offline floors (recall@5 0.300) and, before that, the byte-identical-to-lexical placeholder numbers. REAL measured values from this run: recall@5 0.550, mrr 0.356 (chat 0.777/0.498, deep 0.625/0.431), schema 0/0 — reproduced identically across two runs. This is the honest AFTER the design doc depends on: over the lexical baseline (recall@5 0.100, mrr 0.055) the hosted embedder is a 5.5x recall@5 lift and a 6.5x MRR lift, and it clears the earlier keyless offline floor (recall@5 0.300) by ~1.8x — synonym/paraphrase recall the offline bag-of-words model could not provide. Bars sit at those measured values rounded down to three decimals (floors, not targets — same convention as lexical.json). schema stays 0/0: schema intent (exact title/slug lookup) is untouched by the embedder by design. B1 synonym probe ('how do I change my login credentials'): with the real embedder the correct login/CLI doc (cli-reference-vendo-init-login-doctor) stays rank 1, and the TAIL cleans up — pure lexical fills ranks 3-5 with common-token noise (mcp-door, how-vendo-works) while semantic surfaces credential-relevant docs instead (cloud API keys, configuration). The report's literal 'card-dispute doc' framing comes from its source corpus and has NO counterpart in this Vendo fixture set, so this is reported as the analogous in-corpus synonym case, honestly, not fabricated to match. NOTE the refusal layer is still RED for this engine (a broad-cosine hosted embedder still returns cosine hits for off-corpus questions too, same shipped zero-hits weakness policy as lexical) — a calibrated weakness threshold on the now-meaningful semantic score is the follow-up that retires it; until then this engine, like lexical, is not on the per-PR refusal-gated path. Reproduce with an embedding key set: VENDO_KNOWLEDGE_EMBED=on VENDO_MODEL_KNOWLEDGE_EMBEDDER=gemini-embedding-2 pnpm corpus knowledge-eval --engine semantic. Raising or lowering any bar requires a PR editing this file with a one-line justification.
